emerging_technology: Large language models (generative AI for text)
intended_application: Generating product descriptions and marketing copy for an online catalog
business_need: Launching 2,000+ new products per season faster than copywriters can write listings
users_stakeholders: Marketing team, merchandisers, customers, brand leadership
capabilities_constraints: Cloud-native stack; two data engineers; comfortable with SaaS APIs; small copywriting team
risk_consequence_context: Low to moderate: errors are reversible and mostly reputational; some risk of inaccurate product claims
management_question: Should the company make LLM-generated copy the default for new listings, with spot-check review?
